messages:
ida: Quick proposal: 30-min "Launchpad Hothouse" webinar  3 tight micro-demos (7 min each) + 10-min live Q&A. Outcome: attendees leave with 3 copyable tactics to lower latencies, cut token cost, and improve embedding UX. Need confirmed speakers + 1-sentence abstracts by EOD Fri.
sam: Good framing. Working title: 'Launchpad Hothouse: Fast Inference Playbooks'. Reg form should capture primary_interest (benchmarks | quant | embeddings) and team_size bucket. Recommend a hidden utm=launchpad_hothouse.
marco: I'll take Demo 3 (customer embed search). Will ask Maya for a 20-30s recorded clip for fallback. Wed rehearsal 09:00 PT works for me.
ava: Ops: must have a failover plan per demo (90s clip + cached outputs) and 5 validation prompts each. We'll test streaming capture vs full-response in tech-check. I'll prepare a 5-row CSV of test vectors by Thu EOD.
ops-bot: calendar: "Launchpad Hothouse  Tech Check + Rehearsal" created Wed 2024-05-15 09:00 PT  https://calendar.internal/evt/7801
ida: Seed abstracts (please expand to 1-2 sentences):
- Demo 1 (benchmarks): "Practical batching & prefix cache adjustments that cut per-token cost ~3x while keeping p99 steady."
- Demo 2 (quant): "Real-world quantization: what to test, how to surface regressions, and rollback strategies."
- Demo 3 (customer): "Embedding-first search with routing & tiny-model fallbacks: customer story hitting sub-60ms answers."
sam: Lead routing: attach hidden tag interest=[benchmarks|quant|embeddings]. Route benchmarks -> SDR_A, others -> SDR_B. Export segmented list daily. Also set conversion events: webinar_registered, demo_played, lead_assigned.
marco: Compact run-of-show proposal:
00:00 Host intro (ida)
02:00 Demo 1 - Benchmarks (sam)
09:00 Demo 2 - Quant & Checks (sam)
16:00 Demo 3 - Customer (marco + maya)
23:00 Live Q&A (panel)
30:00 Close + CTAs (trial link / request enterprise demo)
ida: Need 3-line pivot scripts for each demo + 5 edge-case prompts to validate. Also ask PR to sign off on customer clip usage and a short quote.
pr: Will review clip and provide suggested quote. Need final timestamps from ops within 24h after event to make the highlight reel.
maya: Confirmed for Demo 3. I'll share a short clip + a 1-paragraph case blurb by Thu and join rehearsal Wed 09:00 PT.
ava: Ops note: capture separate audio tracks, record locally, and keep a 2-minute highlight reel draft for on-demand. I'll upload fallback clips and vectors to the shared drive by Thu EOD.
sam: I'll draft reg copy + two subject lines for the invite A/B test (short Vs descriptive). Also include a hidden marketing_source field for routing.
ida: Final asks: speakers drop 1-sentence abstracts into doc by EOD Fri; marketing ops wire segmented exports to SDR queues; ops confirm fallback playback flow. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
